title: Safe Calculator
description:
```
> 10 / 0
Error [MathError]: division by zero
> sqrt(-4)
Error [DomainError]: sqrt of negative number
> 5 + * 3
Error [ParseError at col 5]: unexpected '*'
```
requirements: Tokenizer + recursive-descent parser for `+ - * / ^ ()` and functions
Main loop catches specific errors first, then `std::exception`, then `...`
Never crashes on any input — fuzz it with random strings
